name: Coordinator loop-failed (run-anchor) → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — the coordinator zombie-hole closer, anchor branch 1 of 2 (loops carrying agent.run.entity-id). The gap the slice closes (ADR §E): NO loop-failed-pause rule lists the coordinator role, and the upstream D3 zombie guard fires only while phase==dispatched (agentrun.go:572). So a coordinator that fails involuntarily WHILE the run is executing leaves the run permanently `executing` with no downstream rule waiting on it.

WHICH coordinators this covers (the adversarial 4a′ review boundary — pinned structurally by test/contract TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage):
  - This rule (the agent.run.entity-id branch) covers executing-flow coordinators that carry agent.run.entity-id via the loop-inherit chain: research RECOVERY (research/06, fired on research roles that carry bare agent.run), the autoresearch-BASELINE recovery branch (autoresearch/10 firing on baseline, which carries agent.run.entity-id from run_scope=new), and the dev-via-test FIRST-PASS-Lisa needs_clarification recovery branch (dev-via-test/02f, first-pass Lisa carries agent.run.entity-id from run_scope=new). These are the anchor_inherit recovery coordinators — their firing role has a bare agent.run, so the spawned coordinator inherits the run anchor.
  - Sibling rule 06 (the lineage branch) covers the lineage-threading coordinators: the dev-via-test intermediate/escalate coordinators (02b, 02d, 05, 07d) AND the run-entity-descended recovery coordinators that ADR-053 4b-1a wired (autoresearch/10b; dev-via-test 02e, 02f-replan, 07b, 07e), which thread agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id explicitly because their firing role carries no bare agent.run.
  - NOT covered, by design: the POST-APPROVAL wake-up coordinators (research/07, autoresearch/08, dev-via-test/07a) — their parent rule stamps agent.run.outcome=success, so rule 03 completes the run BEFORE the woken coordinator runs; its later failure is post-terminal, not a zombie.
  - ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a CLOSED the former 4b deferral: every recovery coordinator now carries a readable anchor (anchor_inherit here when the firing role has a bare agent.run; anchor_threaded on rule 06 otherwise). No coordinator-spawn path is left without executing→failed coverage.
  (The DISPATCH coordinator cannot fail while executing: it terminated when it spawned the first child; a dispatch coordinator that fails BEFORE handoff stays `dispatched` and is D3's job.)

FIRING-ENTITY BRIDGE (the 2-step marker, same as 01-handoff-marker): lifecycle_transition acts on the firing entity, but a coordinator failure fires on the coordinator LOOP. This rule stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity via the subject override $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id; rule 04 then matches the marker on the run entity (+ phase==executing) and transitions executing→failed.

ANCHOR FENCE (length_eq 0): agent.run.entity-id is framework-inherited down an unbroken loop-spawn chain (a publish_agent from a loop copies the firing loop's bare agent.run into the child's RunID, which re-stamps agent.run.entity-id — verified graph_writer.go:535-539 + actions.go:1258-1268). Coordinators spawned by a rule firing ON the run entity (dev-via-test/02d, 07d) carry only agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id and are handled by sibling rule 06, fenced on lineage PRESENCE (length_gt 0). The two are mutually exclusive on agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id presence, the same corruption-to-no-op discipline as dev-via-test 02 vs 02g.

RUN-LESS-CHAT GUARD: agent.run.entity-id != "" excludes a non-delegating coordinator answering plain chat (no run_scope=new fired → no run anchor) — its loop-failure has no run to fail and must not attempt a phantom transition.

TRIGGER SHAPE: agent.loop.outcome IN [failed, truncated] — the involuntary terminal-failure class (model timeout, panic, max_iterations without a decide, context blowout). A coordinator that successfully decides terminates outcome=success and never matches here, so this is disjoint from the decide-driven spawn/wake-up rules. cancelled is OUT of scope (deliberate abort → Phase 4b).

metadata.covers: executing-flow coordinators carrying agent.run.entity-id via the loop-inherit chain (the anchor_inherit class): research recovery (research/06) + the autoresearch-baseline recovery branch (autoresearch/10) + the dev-via-test first-pass-Lisa needs_clarification recovery branch (dev-via-test/02f). NOT the post-approval wake-ups (research/07, autoresearch/08, dev-via-test/07a — those complete via rule 03 first). The lineage-anchor coordinators are rule 06's. ADR-053 4b-1a closed the former deferral — the run-entity-descended recovery coordinators now thread lineage and route to rule 06. Boundary pinned by TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage.
metadata.anchor_fence: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0 makes this mutually exclusive with rule 06 (length_gt 0), so a coordinator carrying both anchors (dev-via-test 02b/05 wake-ups) routes to 06 and is never double-stamped. Same fence as dev-via-test 02 vs 02g.
metadata.run_less_chat_guard: agent.run.entity-id != "" — a plain-chat coordinator has no run anchor and must not stamp a phantom failed marker.
metadata.d3_boundary: Rule 04b (dispatched->failed, the product-owned replacement for the beta.160-deleted upstream D3 guard) consumes this rule's stamp for dispatched-phase root failures; rule 04 consumes it for executing-phase failures. Disjoint by phase — no double-fire.
